label: Single Forward Pleat
description: A single forward pleat is one fold per side that opens inward toward the fly, the direction associated with English tailoring. It adds room across the front of the thigh that collapses when standing, keeping a streamlined, slimming front line. Drawing the eye inward, forward pleats look narrower and tidier than reverse ones.

garment.noun: pair of bespoke wool tailored trousers
garment.fabric: fine wool trouser cloth with visible weave
